instruction.text: Sort the objects by category into the three baskets.

semantic_contract: Group all objects of the same category together, using a separate basket for each category.
Lower the objects into the baskets rather than leaving them above the openings.
Both arms must be back at the poses they held when the episode reset, at the same instant that everything else in this contract is true.
